name: Servry
tagline: Enterprise infrastructure for the invisible restaurant.
positioning: Servry operates and orchestrates delivery-only kitchen networks for multi-brand food operators, from lease to line to last mile.

hero.h1: The operating layer for delivery-only kitchen networks.
hero.sub: Servry gives enterprise food operators one control plane for facilities, staffing, menu deployment, and order routing across every ghost kitchen site — with margin visibility down to the ticket.

features.title: Multi-brand menu deployment
features.description: Push a new virtual brand to 40 kitchens in an afternoon — recipes, station cards, and channel listings synced across DoorDash, Uber Eats, and your own app.

features.title: Station-level throughput
features.description: See prep time, ticket age, and expo bottlenecks per line in real time. Servry flags the station dragging down your fulfillment SLA before the region does.

features.title: Order routing intelligence
features.description: Route demand to the kitchen with the shortest queue and lowest delivery radius, automatically rebalancing during peak without a dispatcher touching it.

features.title: Facilities & compliance ledger
features.description: Every hood cleaning, temp log, and health inspection tracked per site, with audit-ready exports mapped to local jurisdictions.

features.title: Unified margin reporting
features.description: Blend food cost, labor, commission, and rent into one contribution-margin view per brand, per kitchen, per daypart.

features.title: Capacity planning
features.description: Model new sites and brand launches against forecasted demand before you sign a lease or hire a single line cook.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated eleven kitchen management tools into Servry. Menu launches that took two weeks now take an afternoon, and our regional GMs finally trust the margin numbers.
testimonials.name: Daniela Reyes

testimonials.quote: Servry's routing engine cut our average ticket age by 31% across the Northeast cluster. The health-compliance ledger alone justified the contract during our last audit.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Before Servry we couldn't tell you which virtual brand was actually profitable in which market. Now capacity planning is a board-level conversation backed by real data.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
